rows.known: Figma label on a primary is #FAFAFA, code uses #FFFFFF. Both pass AAA (7.7:1 and 8.0:1).
Same as Surface A: #FAFAFA in Figma, #FFFFFF in code.
Figma secondary label in dark is #F7F9FA, code inherits --color-fg #FAFAFA. Visually the same.
Figma general/border is neutral/200 #E5E5E5; the shelf border is --gt-line #D5DBE1 (border-level-3). Open decision: which one is the default card border.
Same open decision as Surface A: Figma #E5E5E5 vs shelf #D5DBE1.
Figma chart 5 (light) is Green 700 #14784C; code chart-a-5 is #116841. Open decision.
Figma shadows/md is the Tailwind default (two layers); code --shadow-md is one softer layer. Open decision: which one is the elevation-3 shadow.
Figma shadows/lg is the Tailwind default; code --shadow-lg is one layer. Same open decision as md.
Figma shadows/xl is the Tailwind default; code --shadow-xl (added in v1.4.0) is two softer layers. Same open decision as md.
